## FOLLOW-UP SEQUENCES

Runs daily at 10 AM to calculate follow-ups based on:
- Lead status (Qualified, Active, Cold)
- Days since last contact
- Lead score

THREE SEQUENCES:

1. NEW LEADS (Days 1-7)
   - Day 2: More properties
   - Day 3: Viewing availability
   - Day 5: New listings alert
   - Day 7: Call reminder

2. ACTIVE/VIEWING (Days 1-30)
   - Day 3: Similar properties
   - Day 7: Questions check
   - Day 14: Market update
   - Day 21: Status check
   - Day 30: Re-engagement

3. COLD (Every 2 weeks)
   - Bi-weekly market updates
   - Low-pressure check-ins

Engagement tracked in sheet.
Reactivates 3-5 deals/year = $9K-15K!
